description: Passive subdomain-takeover fingerprints. A dangling CNAME plus a provider error page is an INDICATOR requiring authorized manual verification, never proof of takeover.

providers.name: GitHub Pages
http_indicators: There isn't a GitHub Pages site here
For root URLs (like http://example.com/) you must provide an index.html file
404 There is no GitHub Pages site here
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to <user>.github.io; unclaimed repository returns a GitHub 404 page
false_positive_warnings: Private repositories also return 404; verify the target is claimable by the tester

providers.name: Heroku
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to a Heroku app hostname; deleted apps leave the alias dangling
false_positive_warnings: Custom maintenance pages can mimic the no-such-app page

providers.name: Amazon S3
http_indicators: The specified bucket does not exist
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME/alias to an S3 website or bucket endpoint; deleted buckets return NoSuchBucket
false_positive_warnings: Bucket may exist but be privately owned; do not attempt to claim it

providers.name: Microsoft Azure
http_indicators: The requested URI does not represent any resource on the server
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to an Azure regional hostname; deleted services leave the record dangling
false_positive_warnings: Azure returns similar errors for stopped, not deleted, services

providers.name: Netlify
http_indicators: Looks like you've followed a broken link
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to a Netlify site; deleted sites leave custom domains unclaimed
false_positive_warnings: Generic 404 text may originate from the application itself

providers.name: Vercel
http_indicators: The deployment could not be found on Vercel
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to Vercel; removed deployments return DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND
false_positive_warnings: Preview deployments can also be intentionally inaccessible

providers.name: Shopify

providers.name: Fastly
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to Fastly service; detached services return unknown-domain errors

providers.name: Amazon CloudFront
http_indicators: ERROR: The request could not be satisfied
The request could not be satisfied.
providers.dns_behavior: CNAME to a CloudFront distribution; deleted distributions return generic errors
false_positive_warnings: CloudFront emits this generic error for many non-takeover conditions; manual review required
